summary.name: Screen Studio
summary.one_liner: A macOS screen recorder that adds automatic zooms, smoothed cursor motion, and editing tools (transcript-based editing, noise reduction, masks) to produce polished product demos and tutorials.
use_cases: Making social media videos in multiple aspect ratios
Recording app demos from iPhone or iPad over USB
Hiding API keys or emails in screen recordings
Cleaning up voice and removing filler words from narration
summary.what_it_does: Screen Studio records a whole display, a window, or a selected area on macOS, with optional webcam and microphone or system sound. It records the screen without the cursor and stores precise cursor data separately, so it can smooth cursor paths, change cursor size and style, and add click ripples after recording. Zooms can be automatic (based on clicks) or manual, and the same take can be re-framed for wide, square, and vertical formats. Editing includes transcript-based cuts, filler-word and pause removal, on-device noise reduction, post-recording masks and highlights, and backgrounds/shadows presets. The page says transcription and voice processing run locally, with cloud features optional.
notable: Automatic zoom on clicks, with manual zoom option and smooth cursor movement applied after recording
Built on Apple's ScreenCaptureKit and optimized for Apple silicon
Local processing for transcription, noise reduction, face tracking and export; cloud features optional
Can record iPhone or iPad over USB and wrap it in a device mockup
caveats: Mac only; the page says it is made for Mac and nothing else
Subscription pricing: monthly $29/mo or yearly $9/mo (save 69%); one-time licenses are no longer sold for new purchases
